instruction: Turn on the night light feature to reduce blue light from the screen during evening hours.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling night light mode by setting org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.color night-light-enabled to true. Evaluator verifies the setting value using gsettings get command.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts night light setting state using 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.color night-light-enabled'
Metric 'exact_match' correctly compares command output against expected value 'true\n'
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct - includes newline as returned by gsettings commands
Evaluator completely verifies the instruction requirement: checking that night-light-enabled is set to true
Data flow is correct: getter extracts gsettings output → metric performs exact string comparison
No postconfig needed - gsettings state persists and can be queried at any time
Edge cases handled: if command fails, getter returns None and metric returns 0.0
